text: The purpose of this report is to present the 2020 third quarter financial results to the Board.

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approved the 2020 third quarter financial operating results, as noted in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (October 26, 2020) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Attachment 2 to the report (October 26, 2020) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live remain confidential in its entirety because if disclosed, could reasonably be expected to prejudice significantly the competitive position or interfere significantly with the contractual or other negotiations of a person, group of persons, or organization.
